description: This file defines a utility class PublisherUtilities within the namespace Todaymade\Daux\Format\Confluence. It provides static methods for processing titles and determining if content should be updated based on similarity thresholds.

classes.name: PublisherUtilities
classes.description: A utility class containing static methods for handling publication-related tasks such as generating nice titles and deciding whether to update content based on similarity thresholds.

methods.name: niceTitle
methods.description: Generates a human-readable title from a filename, replacing 'index.html' with 'Homepage' and trimming other HTML extensions.

methods.name: shouldUpdate
methods.description: Determines whether the local content should be updated based on comparison with published content, considering a similarity threshold and optionally logging debug info.
